# dodopayments_entitlement (Data Source)

Reads one entitlement by its ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dodopayments_entitlement" "example" {
  integration_config = {
    feature_id   = "example-entitlement"
    feature_type = "boolean"
  }
  integration_type = "feature_flag"
  metadata = {
    tier = "pro"
  }
  name = "example-entitlement"
}

data "dodopayments_entitlement" "example" {
  id = dodopayments_entitlement.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the entitlement.

### Read-Only

- `business_id` (String) Identifier of the business that owns this entitlement.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the entitlement was created.
- `description` (String) Optional description supplied at creation.
- `integration_config` (Attributes) Integration-specific configuration. For `digital_files` entitlements
this includes presigned download URLs for each attached file. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--integration_config))
- `integration_type` (String) Platform integration this entitlement uses.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Always `true` for entitlements returned by the public API;
soft-deleted entitlements are not returned.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Arbitrary key-value metadata supplied at creation or via PATCH.
- `name` (String) Display name supplied at creation.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the entitlement was last modified.

<a id="nestedatt--integration_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `integration_config`

Read-Only:

- `activation_message` (String) Optional message displayed when a customer activates the license
key (≤ 2500 characters).
- `activations_limit` (Number) Maximum activations allowed per issued license key. Omit for unlimited.
- `chat_id` (String) Telegram chat ID. For groups this is typically a negative integer.
- `digital_files` (Attributes) Populated digital-files payload with each file's metadata and a
short-lived presigned download URL. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--integration_config--digital_files))
- `duration_count` (Number) Validity duration of issued license keys. Provide both
`duration_count` and `duration_interval` together for a fixed
duration; omit both for non-expiring keys.
- `duration_interval` (String) Unit of `duration_count`.
- `feature_id` (String) Merchant-chosen identifier for the capability this entitlement unlocks.
- `feature_type` (String) Type of capability conferred. Only `boolean` is supported today.
- `figma_file_id` (String) Figma file identifier to grant access to.
- `framer_template_id` (String) Framer template identifier to grant access to.
- `fulfillment_mode` (String) How license keys are fulfilled. `auto` (default) generates and delivers
keys to customers automatically; `manual` creates pending grants that you
fulfill with the supplied key via `POST /grants/{grant_id}/license-key`.
- `guild_id` (String) Discord guild (server) ID.
- `notion_template_id` (String) Notion template identifier to grant access to.
- `permission` (String) Permission to grant on the repository.
- `role_id` (String) Optional Discord role to assign within the guild.
- `target_id` (String) Repository or organisation slug to grant access to.

<a id="nestedatt--integration_config--digital_files"></a>
### Nested Schema for `integration_config.digital_files`

Read-Only:

- `external_url` (String) Optional external URL, passed through from the entitlement
configuration.
- `files` (Attributes List) One entry per attached file. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--integration_config--digital_files--files))
- `instructions` (String) Optional human-readable delivery instructions, passed through from
the entitlement configuration.

<a id="nestedatt--integration_config--digital_files--files"></a>
### Nested Schema for `integration_config.digital_files.files`

Read-Only:

- `content_type` (String) Optional content-type declared at upload. A JSON document. Use `jsonencode()` to set it.
- `download_url` (String) Short-lived presigned URL for downloading the file. A JSON document. Use `jsonencode()` to set it.
- `expires_in` (String) Seconds until `download_url` expires. A JSON document. Use `jsonencode()` to set it.
- `file_id` (String) Identifier of the attached file. A JSON document. Use `jsonencode()` to set it.
- `file_size` (String) Optional size of the file in bytes. A JSON document. Use `jsonencode()` to set it.
- `filename` (String) Original filename of the attached file. A JSON document. Use `jsonencode()` to set it.
